skills.name: test-first-repair
skills.description: For repairs: reproduce the failure with the named tests before touching code, fix the cause the failure names, and close by re-running the same tests.

skills.name: minimal-diff-discipline
skills.description: For any task: the smallest change that fully answers it — no opportunistic refactors, no renames, no reformatting of code the task did not name.

skills.name: read-the-callers-first
skills.description: Before changing a function's behaviour: find its callers, read what they rely on, and keep the contract they were written against.
